info.title: Event Ticketing Phase 1 local API
info.description: Implemented AUTH-01–11 and ORG-01–09 contracts. Local owner decisions are recorded in the Phase 1 execution plan. Production policy and later commerce operations are outside this contract.

file.description: PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 5242880 bytes; server validates signature and type

post.summary: Resend email verification with a generic 60-second cooldown response

202.description: Generic accepted response, including unknown or ineligible accounts and requests during cooldown

AuthContext.description: Navigation only; never grants roles. Omitted context uses Customer. Paths are relative to the selected portal.

returnUrl.description: Allowlisted internal task path, e.g. /home or /check-in/events. External URLs, auth routes and control characters are rejected.
